name: Anchoïade

instructions.primary_message: Fit the food processor with a blade, and set it to whirl. Drop in the garlic, so it smashes to smithereens. Drop in all the anchovies at once. Add the olive oil and vinegar. Then stop the machine, scrape down the sides, and whiz until pretty smooth.
Spoon into a small bowl and serve with a few handfuls of fresh sugar snaps, or spoon it over roasted red and yellow peppers, or serve it as a dip for olive bread.

schema_metadata.keywords: anchovies, condiments, dips, French in a Flash, spreads

description: Anchoïade is a quirky alternative to tapenade made from just four ingredients: anchovies, garlic, olive oil, and vinegar. Serve it as a dip for crudités or as a spread for bread, all with a glass of white wine or rosé.
notes: Notes: If you want to mellow out your anchovies, soak then in milk for 15 minutes, pat them dry, and then use them in this recipe.
author: Kerry Saretsky
